title: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollmen
question:
Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment can be computed by `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_047, s.XCL_067
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.XCL_019 - f2.XCL_024)
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.XCL_001 = s2.XCL_041
    WHERE s2.XCL_065 = 'Locally funded'
  );
